correctness.rationale: The assumptions, norm-square Paley isomorphism, all 6,349 faces, every Hasse incidence, all Morse match pairs, the integral signed Morse projection, and 20 unimodular pivots followed by gcd 9 are recomputed by the decoded self-contained standard-library verifier. The final 21x141 boundary has full row rank, so H2 is Z/9 and H3 is free of rank 120; absent critical degrees make every other reduced homology zero. A separately enumerated mod-two boundary-rank calculation agrees in all degrees. The matrix in the package independently matches a recorded SHA256. No finite-to-infinite generalization or complete homotopy conclusion is claimed.

value.rationale: The toroidal queens complex is a canonical all-sizes configuration complex from a classical combinatorial problem; the order-seven board is the next feasible square torus after order five. Its 49-vertex flag complex is an important strongly regular Paley graph. An order-nine integral torsion class is not revealed by finite face counts, clique classifications, rational Betti numbers, or mod-two computations. The exact primary torsion and free rank provide a topologically informative benchmark for square-order Paley flag complexes and integral torsion in natural graph complexes, rather than an arbitrary slice or textbook consequence.
